title: Active Directory Attack & Defense Playbook
description: AD engagement playbook: domain enumeration, Kerberos abuse (AS-REP roasting, Kerberoasting, golden/silver tickets), LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning, pass-the-hash, delegation and ACL abuse, GPO and trust attacks.
when_to_use: Windows/AD domains, Kerberos-based networks, or post-exploitation on domain-joined hosts.
